**q23.**
SQL schema: `store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql:33`
Go store model: `store/memo.go:35`
API proto message: `proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto:198`
Generated frontend types: `web/src/types/proto/api/v1/memo_service_pb.ts:79`

**q24.**
`web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts` (useCreateMemo hook)
`web/src/connect.ts` (memoServiceClient)
`proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto` (CreateMemo RPC)
`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` (APIV1Service.CreateMemo handler)
`store/memo.go` (Store.CreateMemo)
`store/db/sqlite/memo.go` (DB.CreateMemo — INSERT INTO memo)

**q25.** CEL (Common Expression Language) engine at `internal/filter/engine.go`; the CEL expression is compiled into an AST, walked by `internal/filter/parser.go` into a dialect-agnostic IR condition tree, then rendered to dialect-specific SQL by `internal/filter/render.go` which switches on DialectSQLite/DialectPostgres/DialectMySQL. Each DB driver calls `engine.CompileToStatement()` passing its own dialect via `filter.RenderOptions`.

**q26.** `memo_relation`, `attachment`, `memo`, `memo_share` (via ON DELETE CASCADE FK). Recursively, comment memos and their own `memo_relation` and `attachment` rows are also deleted.

**q27.** `go:embed` — the compiled frontend `dist/` is embedded into the Go binary via `//go:embed dist/*` and served through Echo static middleware with SPA fallback; `server/router/frontend/frontend.go`

**q28.**
S3 Presign Runner — `time.NewTicker` every 12 hours (+ RunOnce at startup), `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go`
Unused infrastructure: `internal/scheduler/` provides a full cron scheduler but is never imported by any non-test code. `server/runner/memopayload/` has a Runner struct that is never instantiated — only the standalone `RebuildMemoPayload()` function is used inline in API handlers.

**q29.**
Interceptor: `web/src/connect.ts:156` (`authInterceptor`, a ConnectRPC Interceptor)
Token kinds: short-lived JWT access tokens (15 min, in-memory + localStorage) and long-lived JWT refresh tokens (30 days, HTTP-only cookie `memos_refresh`); also Personal Access Tokens (PAT)
Backend validation package: `server/auth/` (`Authenticator` in `server/auth/authenticator.go`)

**q30.**
memos.memo.created: `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` (memo_service.go:157)
memos.memo.updated: `DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook` (memo_update_helpers.go:67)
memos.memo.deleted: `DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook` (memo_service.go:562)
memos.memo.comment.created: `DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook` (memo_service_comments.go:119)
Delivery convergence: `webhook.PostAsync` → `webhook.Post` in `internal/webhook/webhook.go`
